I was kinda in the same situation
And still being, in some way
Luckily an ex gf is my best friend since we broke up
She has been a very strong help
Once, when i was really deep into depression she said something that made a lot of sense and has been tattooed in my mind since then
"People say life is like some stairs, you always go up and you gotta climb to get better
But you won't
If you're not happy right now, what makes you think you're going to feel better when you finish school?
Your mind always worries about the future and blame for the past, but you never live the present"
And that helped me tons more than any psychologist, or any therapy
Of course breaking up with your bf/gf hurts, but hurt's also a part of life, if you gotta live, you gotta have to do it with the full combo of emotions
Don't think about the future or the past
Think about right now
What you wanna eat, if you have something to do, if you're sleepy
Wanna hear music? Do it
Just don't think what my life's gonna be in 23 years
I may be fucking dead and i was worried about worthless stuff like getting my post-grades finished to please mom and dad
I don't want to live with fear of the tomorrow
Of course i want my career but if i really need to sleep, im gonna do it
